status: VERIFIED_ANALYSIS; manuscript/SI/reviewer response insertion and final QA remain parent-owned
scope: Post-review reuse of 226 cases, 1951 archived accepted proposals, 990 reference parts in 60 categories. No new independent samples.

validation.independent_validation: Separate table/invariant check; not an independent dataset or replication.

main_text_replacement: The shared-input audit reproduced all 226 frozen HPID maps and every archived HPID/DBSCAN evaluation endpoint from the same 1,951 accepted proposals. DBSCAN retained the higher part F1 (0.3550 versus 0.3133; HPID minus DBSCAN -0.0417, category-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0601, -0.0244]). A read-only trace followed all 990 reference parts through fine-fusion ownership and Part-ID construction. Semantic ownership reduced available proposal support, although later detail reassignment recovered some support; the detail gate increased mean best-reference IoU while decreasing it for 195/990 references. No remainder component was attached on these cases, and replaying the already accepted pool removed no further candidates. Consequently, neither shared upstream filtering nor remainder attachment explains the observed gap. These diagnostics describe run states rather than an additive causal decomposition of the difference between algorithms.
supplement_methods: We used sys.settrace to read copied arrays from the unchanged frozen fuse_candidates and _hierarchical_part_ids functions. The same ordered candidate objects were then supplied to the unchanged DBSCAN implementation; input-mask hashes remained unchanged. All source/script hashes, code-line observation points, per-case statistics and 990 reference tracks are supplied. Before the first real semantic argmax, evidence arrays were copied and read with the final background convention; these four provisional argmaxes are explicitly diagnostic and are not emitted intermediate predictions. Actual semantic states and Part-ID assignment masks were recorded separately. Every stage used the same evaluator normalization and root-as-body convention. Best-reference IoU is an oracle geometry diagnostic that may select a different mask at successive stages; same-semantic union recall divides by the same reference mask area. Reference-part counts are descriptive, not independent statistical replication. Summaries first average within each case; intervals sample the 60 categories with replacement and retain all cases within sampled categories (10,000 draws, seed 20261008). Intervals are pointwise exploratory estimates, with no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim.
supplement_results: The accepted-pool reference coverage was 0.634387 for any semantics and 0.251496 for matching semantics; final HPID coverage was 0.562664 and 0.147054, respectively. At the first actual semantic argmax, matching-semantic coverage was 0.130195; the subsequent direct-detail gate raised it to 0.147386 but lowered it for 63/990 reference parts. Mean best-reference IoU increased by 0.016952 (95% CI [0.010961, 0.023223]) at this gate, with 195/990 references decreasing and 389/990 increasing. Cleanup changed matching-semantic coverage by -0.000320 (95% CI [-0.000833, 0.000121]). Identity partition lowered matching-semantic coverage for 29/990 references, by -0.000052 in case-macro mean, while improving best-reference IoU on average through splitting. Two additional eligible remainder masks entered the evaluated representation and were retained separately; none was attached. Final area/sliver filtering removed 23 evaluated masks, and the full run recorded 14 visibility-sliver drops, preserved all 354 matches at IoU 0.25, and raised macro F1 from 0.310703 to 0.313311 despite small support losses. DBSCAN and HPID each emitted 1,277 evaluated masks, but DBSCAN matched 397 references versus 354 and had higher mean best-reference IoU (0.273483 versus 0.239501).
boundaries: Exported candidates are the already accepted fine-fusion pool. Zero replay removals does not establish that original proposal generation/deduplication removed nothing; pre-rejection candidates are unavailable.
Named three-stage semantic/structural/appearance verification happens later during Group construction and is distinct from the fine-fusion direct-detail gate traced here.

Intermediate masks have different representations (overlapping proposals, per-class support, then exclusive instances). Do not sell their diagnostic F1 differences as ablated algorithm superiority or additive causal effects.
The provisional parent-support/readout changes occur before actual argmax. Their stage differences must not be described as literal emitted-mask deletion.
No archived DBSCAN map was compared in this audit, so the reproduction claim is all numeric evaluator endpoints (exact), not archived map byte identity.
Geometry improvements and identity-interface guarantees are separate. Higher DBSCAN spatial scores must remain visible.
